note: Single-polarity positive (row annotation). TestRTRPollsAtLeastHourly: after an End of Data with zero interval fields, pollDelay(true) and pollDelay(false) are both at most one hour; the running cacheGroup queries again when the wait ends (Reset then Serial on the wire with a 1s wait), so the loop does re-query. TestRFC6810DefaultPollCadenceIsHourly keeps the fresh-session defaults.
